title: Grateful Dead Live at Denver Coliseum on 1973-11-20
lineage: 1st (possibly 2nd) Generation Reels (Akai GX-636)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp 2496> Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Master Soundboard Cassettes > Will Boswell's 1st generation Reels @ 3.75 ips

ai_review.summary: Stunning soundboard capture of a soulful, flawless show highlighted by Brown‑Eyed Women, Beat It On Down the Line, The Race Is On and Row Jimmy.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this performance as one of the band’s best set‑lists ever, noting the soulful playing and flawless execution of every song. The soundboard source delivers clear, crisp audio that lets listeners fully appreciate the heavy groove on Row Jimmy and the country flair of The Race Is On.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and recording quality, indicating an exceptional show with excellent soundboard fidelity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints; reviewers imply crystal‑clear sound that showcases the band’s dynamics.

standout_songs: Beat It On Down the Line
show_quality.setlist_flow: A tightly curated, high‑energy set that balances soulful ballads with heavy country covers, delivering a consistently engaging performance.
